attributes.residual: ONE mechanism remains, and it is now the ONLY one: a whole-function callee-saved PERMUTATION with no schedule component. GPR: the three-register set {r28, r29, r30} is permuted between the streams - the scripted-camera walker is r28 in target / r30 in ours (0x6c-0xe0), the visibility-loop index and the state-machine walker are r30 in target / r29 in ours (0x1f0-0x820), and `shown` is r29 in target / r30 in ours (0x20, 0x320). FPR: f25<->f26 in block 1 (visibilityScale/visibilityAdd) and a mirror over f26..f31 in block 2, plus the knock-on at f27 (`fmuls f27,f26,f0` vs `fmuls f27,f25,f0`). THE MECHANISM IS A DOUBLE BIND, measured twice this run: MWCC drives BOTH the emission order of a block's initializer loads AND its callee-saved numbering from the same declaration order, and in do_enemies those two demand OPPOSITE orders - our emission order already matches the target while our numbering is its mirror, so any reorder that fixes one breaks the other (B1: 0 clusters -> 3; B2: 0 clusters -> 2). That is why the correct keep is the state with the WORSE `real`. Not source-reachable by declaration order in either group. One non-word row to note for the pin lane: at 0x138 target's `lfd f1` binds lbl_803468D0 and ours binds pool entry @711 through the same EMB_SDA21 reloc kind.
